Can Calix's 50G-PON Trial With Astound Accelerate Broadband Growth?
Calix, Inc. CALX has announced the successful completion of a trial of its 50G-PON (passive optical network) access solution with Astound, demonstrating a scalable path for broadband providers to expand network capacity and introduce high-speed services without major network overhauls. The trial highlights Calix's ability to help customers build on existing infrastructure while responding to growing demand for bandwidth-intensive connectivity.
